company.name: Tabreed
company.shortDescription: Tabreed is a cooling company providing sustainable, energy efficient and innovative cooling solutions to government and commercial.
company.description: Ever since Tabreed was commissioned by the UAE Government to construct a district cooling plant in Suweihan in the late 1990s, the company has continued to play a vital role in enabling the nation’s economic development by providing pioneering cooling solutions to key infrastructure projects - first in the UAE, and later, across the GCC.

productsAndServices.description: Provision of centralized cooling solutions through a network of plants supplying chilled water to multiple buildings and developments.

productsAndServices.description: Implementation of energy-saving measures and integration of renewable energy sources in cooling operations to reduce environmental impact.

productsAndServices.description: Provision of comprehensive energy management services including energy audits, consulting, asset upgrades, financing, and maintenance under performance-based contracts.
